units.source_text: 我和这只河童说了一些闲话，诸如关于自杀的托喀，每天请医生看病的嘎尔等等。

en.t: I chatted a little with this kappa, about things like Tock and his thoughts on suicide, Gael who had a doctor examine him every day, and so on.

units.source_text: 不知为何，不过看老河童的表情似乎对这些并不感兴趣。

en.t: For some reason, though, judging from the old kappa's expression, he did not seem interested in any of these things.
